punchline: A team can hit every personal target and still miss the one result it shares.
thirty_sec: The last layer of Lencioni's pyramid is inattention to results. It shows up when people put their own ego, career or recognition ahead of what the team is trying to achieve. Nobody has to act badly. A person can work hard and hit every personal target while the team's goal barely moves. His two practical fixes are to state the team's results publicly, where everyone can see them, and to tie rewards to those results instead of only to individual output.
